title: RIFT Pipeline Latency Specification

stages.description: Query Prometheus/Jaeger; normalize; align to Δt windows
Compute anomaly scores; Strategy D subgraph expansion
Run FCI on G_T variables (≤15 variables per spec)
MSIS greedy selection from candidate set
Wasserstein W1 with permutation test B=10000
Edge confidence + posterior update in closed loop
telemetry + anomaly + FCI + identifiability + EBD CANDIDATE
CANDIDATE + intervention + post-collection + CID + EBD DEFINITIVE + graph_update

measurement_procedure: RIFTRunRecord.pipeline_stages records PipelineStageRecord.duration_s for each stage. Latency is measured as wall-clock time from stage start to stage complete.
honest_note: Latency cannot be measured without live Online Boutique execution on Linux. Targets are from Phase 2/3 spec. Actual values MUST be reported after live run and MUST NOT be artificially tuned to match targets. If actual values differ from targets, report the actual values and investigate the cause.
